message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/compile_fuzzer3.sh << 'EOF'
cd /workspace
SRCDIR="repo-vul/src-vul/readstat/src"
INCLUDES="-I $SRCDIR -I $SRCDIR/spss -I $SRCDIR/sas -I $SRCDIR/stata -I $SRCDIR/test -I $SRCDIR/fuzz"
CFLAGS="-g -fsanitize=address $INCLUDES"

# Compile all necessary source files
for f in \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_bits.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_convert.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_error.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_malloc.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_metadata.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_parser.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_value.c \
  $SRCDIR/readstat_variable.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_sav.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_sav_compress.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_sav_parse.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_sav_parse_timestamp.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_sav_read.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_spss.c \
  $SRCDIR/spss/readstat_spss_parse.c \
  $SRCDIR/sas/ieee.c \
  $SRCDIR/sas/readstat_sas.c \
  $SRCDIR/stata/readstat_dta.c \
  $SRCDIR/stata/readstat_dta_parse_timestamp.c \
  $SRCDIR/CKHashTable.c \
  $SRCDIR/test/test_buffer_io.c \
  $SRCDIR/fuzz/fuzz_format.c; do
  base=$(basename $f .c)
  gcc $CFLAGS -c $f -o /tmp/${base}.o 2>&1
done

echo "=== Compilation done ==="
EOF
bash /tmp/compile_fuzzer3.sh
